messages:
Liz: Quick weekly note — three priorities and a few asks. TL;DR: EU Private beta launch readiness, Dedicated SLA target, and Cost-efficiency wins. Read and react with :thumbsup: if no blockers.

Liz: 1) EU Private beta (pilot customers) — go/no-go check Tuesday morning. Legal needs final DATA_PROC signoff by Mon EOD. @Sofia can you confirm?

Liz: 2) SLA for Dedicated — target 99.95% availability next quarter for paid tiers. Ops: create the runbook + escalation flow. Keep latency SLOs for 95th percentile under 120ms for small prompts.

Liz: 3) Cost ops — Optimize batch/quantization rollout. Early experiments show ~8% token-cost reduction; we should prioritize buckets with high tail latency.

Vikram: Ack. Canary for eu-west-2 scheduled tonight at 23:30 UTC. I will flip traffic 10% -> 50% -> 100% if metrics look stable. Need the rotated DB creds deployed to the canary pods first.

Sofia: Working on DATA_PROC doc now, PR at https://git.internal/repo/PR-982. Two items left: DSR wording and retention window. Legal review ETA Mon 14:00 PT.

Danielle: Support heads-up — we expect a surge on pilot onboarding day. Recommend a temporary triage queue and a runbook for common setup errors (VPC peering, KMS permissions). I'll prep the triage doc and notify CS leads.

ops-bot: deploy:eu-private/canary started by Vikram at 1849994400. Health checks green (6m).

Vikram: Rolling credentials now. Patch in infra repo: `terraform apply -target=module.db_creds -auto-approve`.

Liz: Great — two asks before EOD: (a) Sofia confirm legal signoff time, (b) Danielle post the triage doc link here. If either is at risk, escalate to me and Marco.

Sofia: Confirmed legal review at 14:00 PT. I'll ping here once signed.

Danielle: Triage doc draft posted: https://docs.internal/triage/eu-pilot-setup. Will update with common error logs and KB links.

Liz: Thanks all. If the canary looks good overnight, we’ll proceed Tue morning with pilot invite emails. Watch for the launch checklist in /shared/launchs.

Vikram: Will monitor and post metrics snapshots (latency, error rate, token cost delta).

Liz: Small note: execs ask for one slide on expected customer impact + revenue ramp in next partner sync. Marco, can you take?

(Reaction summary: :thumbsup: x7, :eyes: x3)
